task: Record user's explicit approval of the clarified advisor workflow and explain startup/automatic routing.

constraints.scope: Publish approved workflow clarifications and startup documentation; no new skill creation, payload modification, installation or host integration.

decision.status: Workflow principles approved; documentation recorded. Device deployment and per-project combinations remain distinct.
approved: Main assistant coordinates; Superpowers supplies the preferred software method within the proposed combination.
Skills are instructions, not automatically subagents; direct sequential work remains possible.
Choose the smallest suitable combination by requirements, rather than activating every candidate at each step.
Search relevant installed/repo/external sources including GitHub when useful; trends do not establish best fit.
Define acceptance criteria before work and choose verification tools appropriate to requirements and risks.
Reuse existing skills; existing custom tool-advisor connects stages. Another custom skill needs a concrete uncovered need.
Retain sanitized outcomes and corrections; consult them later and refresh relevant sources. No autonomous background learning, model retraining or automatic skill replacement.
decision.startup: Repo AGENTS.md or installed managed instructions direct substantial requests into tool-advisor. Use explicit 'Use tool-advisor' prompt as fallback. Target device setup and fresh-session discovery must be verified; no universal prompt interception.
not_authorized_by_this_approval: Unreviewed payload changes or new scanner exceptions
New provider charges or background services

evidence.review: Read saved skill, execution contract, startup docs and repo trigger rules. Existing implementation supports the documented coordination contract; no new live end-to-end execution tested.

feedback.text: Alright all seems good and approved.
